WITH manual_rows AS (
                SELECT
                    item_key,
                    media_type::text AS media_type,
                    media_id,
                    title_snapshot,
                    subtitle_snapshot,
                    position_key AS order_number,
                    item_key AS order_text,
                    sort_key,
                    added_at,
                    added_by,
                    NULL::text AS provenance_source,
                    NULL::text AS provenance_imported_from,
                    NULL::text AS provenance_source_key,
                    NULL::text AS provenance_external_media_type,
                    NULL::text AS provenance_external_id,
                    id AS row_id,
                    0 AS membership_rank
                FROM collection_manual_memberships
                WHERE collection_id = $1
            ), source_rows AS (
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(csm.item_key, csm.media_type::text || ':' || csm.media_id::text) AS item_key,
                    csm.media_type::text AS media_type,
                    csm.media_id AS media_id,
                    csm.title AS title_snapshot,
                    NULL::text AS subtitle_snapshot,
                    COALESCE(csm.external_position::numeric, 0::numeric) AS order_number,
                    csm.source_order_key AS order_text,
                    csm.source_order_key AS sort_key,
                    csm.imported_at AS added_at,
                    NULL::uuid AS added_by,
                    CASE cs.provider
                        WHEN 'tmdb' THEN 'tmdb'
                        WHEN 'manual' THEN 'manual'
                        WHEN 'system' THEN 'system'
                        ELSE 'imported'
                    END AS provenance_source,
                    CASE
                        WHEN csm.legacy_movie_collection_tmdb_id IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 'movie_collection_membership'
                        ELSE 'collection_sources'
                    END AS provenance_imported_from,
                    cs.source_key AS provenance_source_key,
                    csm.external_media_type AS provenance_external_media_type,
                    csm.external_id AS provenance_external_id,
                    csm.id AS row_id,
                    1 AS membership_rank
                FROM collection_source_memberships csm
                JOIN collection_sources cs ON cs.id = csm.source_id
                WHERE csm.collection_id = $1
                  AND csm.media_type IS NOT NULL
                  AND csm.media_id IS NOT NULL
            ), combined AS (
                SELECT * FROM manual_rows
                UNION ALL
                SELECT * FROM source_rows
            )
            SELECT
                item_key AS "item_key!",
                media_type AS "media_type!",
                media_id AS "media_id!: Uuid",
                title_snapshot,
                subtitle_snapshot,
                (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    ORDER BY membership_rank, order_number, order_text, row_id
                ) - 1)::int AS "position!",
                sort_key,
                added_at AS "added_at!",
                added_by,
                provenance_source AS "provenance_source?",
                provenance_imported_from AS "provenance_imported_from?",
                provenance_source_key AS "provenance_source_key?",
                provenance_external_media_type AS "provenance_external_media_type?",
                provenance_external_id AS "provenance_external_id?"
            FROM combined
            ORDER BY membership_rank, order_number, order_text, row_id
